title: Sweet Greens
description: A farming & consumable mod focused on flavorful buds & crops
body:
# Sweet Greens

![Book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d9ff138f2dbaa970f356aec4297a98ac7ea156e_0.webp)

A lightweight farming and consumable mod focused on flavorful crops and relaxing potion effects.

***

## Community Server

*   **sweetgreens.g-portal.game**

## Crops

Grow and harvest unique strains, such as:

*   Apple Kush
*   Carrot Kush
*   Wheat Haze
*   +Much More

Each crop can be processed into consumable items with special effects.

## ![crop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2f0d16eeaaed528b2de60de26c45a88092d6b21.png)

## Items

*   Rolling Paper  
    Used to craft rollups.
    
*   Dynamic Rollup  
    Combine with crops to create consumables with different potion effects depending on ingredients.
    

![some items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18111bd45fe83a4b8ec934ca83c4166c3a5752db.png)

***

## Mutation Lab

Create new strain seeds by combining specific ingredients in the Mutation Lab.

*   Insert two matching ingredients to begin a mutation
*   Successful combinations produce brand new crop seeds
*   Recipes are data-driven, making new mutations easy to expand

The Mutation Lab turns progression into discovery, opening new strains through experimentation.

![mutation lab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c18cb79c69d570af41ef1192db8a3d84d94b8d6d.png)

***

## Compressor

Combine any two dried buds in the Compressor to create a `Compressed` mix item.

![compressed item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a466bd9956ed2e5bc6722e622784f2f567b10669.png)

*   The first dried input decides the mix texture
*   Matching effects stack into a stronger effect with the shorter duration
*   Different effects are merged onto the same item
*   Final quality takes the lower quality of the two source buds
*   Mixed strains create hybrid compressed results with dynamic names

![compressor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/701d7d198b61e39ab559364156b5af0b0a5a0ce8.png)

***

## Villagers

Villagers now keep track of how much you sell to them.

*   Each villager builds Chill as you sell
*   At max Chill, that villager refuses further trades
*   Chill slowly drops over time, opening them back up later
*   Chill is saved per villager, so each buyer has their own limit

![chill meter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03c17a9deb95f98536027ae8d102e20a4964a10c.png)

New trading options:

*   Buyer Villager Bookmark for any Trading villager buys your crafted goods

Create a small farming economy.

![trading](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebc208b989bebaf9cc7a09bfbeeba36e47e98e16.png)

***

## Reputation System

Build your name by selling your goods and climbing through reputation titles.

*   Selling certain products can raise or lower your reputation
*   Your current reputation determines your title
*   New journal entries can be locked behind specific reputation titles
*   Early strains are visible immediately, while later strains are revealed as your reputation grows

Current reputation titles:

*   `Scammer`
*   `Green Bean`
*   `Red Meat`
*   `Seasoned Drop`
*   `Known Provider`
*   `Da Plug`

The Canna Journal now doubles as a progression tracker, rewarding higher reputation with access to new strain information.

***

## Discoveries Menu

Open the Discoveries menu with `J` to track which buds and compressed mixes you have actually discovered.

*   Locked entries stay hidden until you have crafted the item and held it in your inventory once
*   The Bud tab shows each discovered strain and its full possible effect set
*   The Compressed tab tracks hybrid combinations and the merged effects they can carry

![compressed discoveries](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17c2d79540a48c6206308c8946b2d665e381f066_0.webp)

***

## Effects

Rollups convert crops into new potion items with unique buffs like:

*   Relaxation
*   Hunger boost
*   Speed / Slowness balance
*   Light visual effects

![dried](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20b25569ee17e2c5eb015967331275294afb0ba3.png)

***

## Quality System

Control crop quality with 3 factors:

*   Heat – growth speed and potency
*   Water – yield and stability
*   Light – effect strength

Better balance results in stronger outcomes.

***

## Notes

*   Designed to be lightweight
*   Works well in vanilla+ modpacks
*   Easy to expand with more crops

***
